1. Take high-resolution photos of the entire family with your phone before moving them anywhere else.
2. Save these images immediately in a dedicated folder on your computer or cloud storage.
3. Transfer the files from your local hard drive to an external USB drive first.
4. Use a reputable backup service like Google Photos or iCloud to complete the transfer securely.
5. Schedule a scheduled "family photo sync" every 90 days to ensure no photos are lost.
6. Check the backup logs daily to verify that all recent uploads were successfully saved.
7. Reinstall the backup app and restore the most recent set of family photos if needed.
8. Review the backup history weekly to check for any missed dates or locations during travel.
9. Test the recovery tool used by your device to make sure it can detect missing files properly.
10. Establish a routine where you always take photos at least once per day to maintain consistency.
